methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote:
Superior Energy Performancecm (SEP) is a forthcoming voluntary 
certification program

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Describes the SEP voluntary certification program/framework and its measurement-and-verification protocol at a programmatic level. It references "normalized energy performance indicators" but identifies and characterises no EnPI/EnB model: no normalisation variables, functional form, or construction/estimation approach are given (the model methodology resides in the external, non-reproduced SEP M&V Protocol for Industry). Maps to the v2.3 ineligible clause: framework/maturity assessment without EnPI/EnB measurement-model content.

paper_type.evidence_quote:
will use the SEP Industrial Facility Best Practice Scorecard to assess 
the maturity of their facility

stage1.notes: Judgment call: paper is topically about energy-performance M&V but presents SEP as a certification framework (incl. a maturity scorecard) without characterising any EnPI/EnB model, so ineligible under the v2.3 bar. paper_type 'other' (program/policy overview) is a defensible alternative to 'maturity model or framework'.
